nearest_text_before.text: О банкротстве собственника задумываются редко. И даже самые дальновидные покупатели порой не знают, что проверка продавца перед сделкой не даёт гарантий.

nearest_text_after.text: Почему банкротство продавца — самый коварный риск

image_reading: A wall clock hangs above a tall stack of clipped paperwork and brown document envelopes on a desk.
The composition is still and tense, with the clock as the clear source of motion and the papers representing the transaction records.
analysis.article_context: Cover image for the warning that a seller’s bankruptcy can surface after an apparently clean purchase: the clock and piled documents emphasize the three-year challenge window and paperwork that cannot reveal every risk.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A seemingly complete set of sale documents does not stop the hidden bankruptcy risk from unfolding over time.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The clock hands are visibly farther forward while the stack of documents remains in place.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The paperwork remains an apparently orderly but insufficient record of the transaction risk.

models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, keep a fixed frame on the clock and document stack. The clock hands begin moving immediately in a measured continuous advance while the papers stay still, letting the visible time progression carry the warning. Near the end, the hands settle into a clearly later position with the stack intact.
models.positive_prompt: The wall clock hands advance steadily as the clipped paperwork remains stacked and clearly visible; by the final frame the hands have visibly moved forward, sustaining the sense of a running deadline.

models.scene_plan: For this independent five-second shot, use a very subtle push-in toward the clock and upper paperwork to focus attention on the deadline. The clock hands advance continuously at an even pace throughout; the movement resolves near the end with a visibly later clock position and the paperwork still waiting below.
models.positive_prompt: A steady close observation of the clock as its hands move forward over the stack of transaction papers, ending with the hands clearly farther ahead while the documents remain in place.

models.scene_plan: Over four seconds, maintain a fixed, restrained composition so the clock and paper stack remain readable. Start the hands advancing at once, with an even moderate progression that lasts almost to the end. The final frame clearly shows the hands later than at the start, preserving the unresolved risk in the documents.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera: the clock hands advance continuously above the stacked documents, ending in a visibly later position while the papers remain unmoved.
